description:
Note:
This Electric Dirt Bike is heavy, please install it carefully with two adults. Make sure the vehicle is properly mounted before playing! The roar is a sound wave imitated by the motor, add driving pleasure.
Powerful Dirt Bike:
This Electric Dirt Bike for Kids is equipped with 300W powerful engine to provide more constant power, and the max load capacity can reach 143 pounds. Tailored for kids aged 3-12. (Data may vary depending on speed mode, weight load, battery, temperature, road conditions, etc.)
Lightning Speed & Long Range:
The EVERCROSS EV12M Electric Dirt Bike can reach a top speed of 15.5 MPH (25KM/H) thanks to its powerful 36V engine. 4AH ultra-long battery life, fully charged mileage up to 9.3 miles. (In addition, Electric Motorcycl has three adjustable speed modes, 5 MPH - 7.5 MPH - 15.5 MPH.)
High-Performance Suspension:
The Motorcycl for kids is equipped with a high-elastic suspension at the rear of the seat, which has super shock absorption ability and reduces the impact of road bumps on the driver. It cooperates with the durm brake system to ensure the driving safety of children.
Comfortable Design:
Electric Dirt Bike is equipped with 12" large-size wear-resistant rubber wheels, which have stronger grip. The high-density non-slip seat is more soft and breathable, and conforms to ergonomic design. It brings children a more comfortable and extreme driving experience.
A Gift For Adventurers:
Give kids this Electric Dirt Bike full of passion and exploration as a gift, it will be a unique surprise for them! Exercise their bravery, curiosity and excellent control and riding ability, let them stand out in the crowd, let's go! Little knight!
Read more about electric motorcycles for kids:
Exploring the Future of Kids' Electric Motorcycles: EVERCROSS EV12M

components.description: Das einfache, aber effektive drum brake system sorgt für sicheres Fahren.
Die robuste chain bietet sowohl Kraft als auch coole Soundeffekte und verleiht Ihrer Fahrt ein aufregendes Element!
Mit der 36-V-5.2-Ah-Batterie können Sie mit einer einzigen Ladung bis zu 15 Kilometer (9.3 Meilen) fahren.
Erleben Sie eine hervorragende Stoßdämpfung, die die Auswirkungen von Straßenunebenheiten auf den Fahrer minimiert.

Der EV12M verfügt über einen robusten und bequemen wasserdichten Sitz.Die Sitzfläche besteht aus wasserdichtem Material mit hoher Dichte. Reinigen Sie nach dem Rennen einfach die Karosserie und Sie erhalten ein brandneues Elektromotorrad.Unter dem Sitz befindet sich eine atmungsaktive und weiche Schwammschicht, um den Fahrkomfort zu verbessern.
